items.title: Pay "processing fee" to release claimed refund
items.quote: Damit wir sie auszahlen können, überweisen Sie bitte die einmalige Bearbeitungsgebühr von 49,90 € bis zum 27.11.2026 auf das Konto IBAN CY17 0020 0128 0000 0012 0052 7600.
items.computation: The letter prints an explicit calendar date for the payment deadline (27.11.2026), so no period calculation is needed; the date is simply used as written.

warnings: This has the classic hallmarks of an advance-fee scam: an unsolicited letter claiming you are owed a refund, conditioned on first paying a smaller 'processing fee' before any money is released.
There is no German authority or utility company named 'Verbraucher-Rückerstattungsstelle Energie'; no real German consumer-refund process requires an upfront fee paid to receive a refund.

The payment account is a Cyprus IBAN (CY...) at an address in Nicosia, Cyprus — a foreign account for an alleged German consumer energy refund is a strong scam indicator and should never be paid into.
The letter uses urgency/pressure tactics ('Verstreicht die Frist, verfällt Ihr Anspruch endgültig') typical of scam mail to rush victims into paying before they can verify the claim.
The letter provides no case reference to any real utility contract, no Steuernummer/Aktenzeichen of any genuine authority, and no verifiable legal basis for the supposed 612,00 € refund.

Recommendation: do not transfer any money, do not reply with personal/bank details, and consider reporting this letter as fraud (e.g. to the Verbraucherzentrale or police) rather than acting on its deadline.
